# Getting help

Ask printing questions in [OpenPrinting's Q&A forum](https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/discussions/categories/q-a).
See [Contact Us](https://openprinting.github.io/contact) for what to include and other community contacts.

Use [this repository's issues](https://github.com/OpenPrinting/openprinting.github.io/issues)
to report website bugs or incorrect content.
